dict.string: TheAll lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch send automation events to other apps.
TheAll lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch capture system audio.
TheAll lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch use the camera.
TheAll needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on your Desktop.
TheAll needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files in your Documents folder.
TheAll needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files in your Downloads folder.
TheAll connects your phone to this Mac on your local network so you can view workspaces and continue AI conversations.
TheAll lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch use the microphone.
TheAll needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on mounted network volumes.
TheAll needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on removable volumes.
